bagPolicy.summary: Bags larger than 10" x 6" x 2" are not permitted inside Barclays Center. Guests without bags can use Express Lanes for faster entry.
bagPolicy.note: Special consideration for medical needs and infant care.

parking.note: Parking options and pricing are not specifically detailed on the page. Visitors are encouraged to use public transportation due to the venue's proximity to major transit hubs.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Barclays Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Barclays Center offers a diverse culinary experience through its Brooklyn Taste program, featuring local neighborhood staples. The venue provides a variety of wine and beer options, including exclusive selections in certain clubs. Craft beer is available at Brooklyn Craft, located outside Section 26.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: All entrances ADA accessible. Elevators on Main Concourse, Suite Levels A & B, and Upper Concourse. Assistive listening devices at Guest Services (Sections 112 & 212). Sensory room near Section 17.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Guest Services outside Section 112 (Main Concourse) or Section 212 (Upper Level).

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Atlantic Ave entrance is the main entry. All entrances are ADA accessible. Access-A-Ride bus stop on Atlantic Ave.
